Technical field

Embodiments of the present invention are related to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that can be realized low consumption electric control.

Background technique

Low consumption as semiconductor integrated circuit (LSI (Large Scale Integration, large scale integrated circuit)) The exemplary process of electric (power saving) control technology, there are as below methods: circuit definitions operating condition and standby shape to control object State, the standby mode about circuit without processing cut down power consumption.

The concrete methods of realizing that power consumption under standby mode is cut down can enumerate by Clock gating cut down dynamic current or Leakage current is cut down by dump.Influence of the Clock gating due to quickly reverting to regular event, to process performance Few, but then, the effect that power consumption is cut down compared with dump is deteriorated.On the contrary, the effect that dump cuts down power consumption is big, But then, it reverts to regular event and expends the time, therefore the influence to software control or process performance is big.

Power reducing and process performance improve in order to balance, it is necessary to carry out control for each application or have with process performance The adjustment of pass, this will lead to the increase of development cost.Such as need such as inferior operation: corresponding to the length of the stand-by time in application Degree, and determine to open or be not turned on power-saving control, or to electricity saving method is only set as to Clock gating or implement Clock gating with Both dumps etc. detailed survey and carry out software installation one by one.

Summary of the invention

Embodiments of the present invention provide a kind of integrated electricity of the semiconductor that can take into account power reducing and process performance raising Road.
